# `browser-tab apply-destructive`

- **Usage**: `browser-tab apply-destructive <--plan <id>> <--confirm-destruction>`

Apply a DESTRUCTIVE act plan (discard/reload) from browser-tab plan

## Flags

### `--plan <id>`

planId from plan_tab_change with riskClass destructive

### `--confirm-destruction`

Required. In-page state is destroyed and cannot be restored
